nuggets.text: Bison coach Ted White is the all-time leading passer in both Howard and MEAC history.
Ted White, a former Bison quarterback, won his first game leading his alma mater, 31-24 over Alabama A&M.
Ja'Shawn Scroggins threw for 315 yards and three touchdowns as the Bison opened the season by beating Alabama A&M.
Se'Quan Osborne caught a 51-yard touchdown with 2:41 left to win the Bison's opener against Alabama A&M.
In 2017 the Bison stunned UNLV 43-40 for the first win over an FBS opponent in program history.
Caylin Newton, younger brother of NFL star Cam Newton, ran for 190 yards in the Bison's 2017 upset of UNLV.
The Bison's top rival is Hampton, and the two schools call their rivalry the Battle of 'The Real HU.'
The Bison have played home games at William H. Greene Stadium since 1926.
Matt Conord went a perfect 3-for-3 on field goals against Alabama A&M, the first three-field-goal game of his career.
Saturday is the first meeting ever between the Bison and Indiana on the football field.
